create.name: Dr. Linda Howe
create.bio:
Dr. Linda Howe is an American teacher and author who has spent around four decades working with the Akashic Records, understood in her tradition as a living archive of each soul's past, present and possible future. Raised in the Midwest, she describes a sudden, overwhelming sense of the divine and of the unity of creation in her mid-twenties, and years later found in the Records the language and practice she had been looking for. The school she set up in 2001, the Linda Howe Center for Akashic Studies, now run from River Forest, Illinois, which has trained thousands of students and certified a network of teachers.

At the heart of her method is the Pathway Prayer Process, a set prayer said partly aloud and partly in silence that she teaches as a careful, disciplined way of opening and closing the Records for oneself or another person. Her recorded certification classes move from reading your own Records to working with old wounds through self-acceptance and then to finding and living your soul's purposes, followed by a teacher training. She also gives a limited number of private readings over Zoom. Among her books are a revised edition of How to Read the Akashic Records, a guide to finding your soul's path and The Heart of the Akashic Records Revealed, and her work now appears in Spanish, Chinese and other languages.

books.title: How to Read the Akashic Records: Accessing the Archive of the Soul and Its Journey (Revised and Updated)
books.author: Linda Howe
books.description: Her core manual, newly revised. It explains what the Records are, sets out the Pathway Prayer Process step by step and covers the ethics of reading for yourself and for others.

books.title: Discover Your Soul's Path Through the Akashic Records
books.author: Linda Howe
books.description: A guide to using the Records to look at the bigger arc of your life: what you came here to do and how to move from ordinary habits toward a fuller expression of yourself.

books.title: The Heart of the Akashic Records Revealed
books.author: Linda Howe
books.description: A broader overview of her whole approach, drawing together the themes of her earlier books and showing how regular work in the Records fits into daily spiritual life.

books.title: Inspired Manifesting Through the Akashic Records
books.author: Linda Howe
books.description: Applies the Records to creating the life you want, treating manifesting as cooperation with the soul's own purposes rather than willpower alone.

courses.title: Akashic Records Practitioner Certification Level I
courses.description: The recorded first-level class in her method, teaching students to open and read the Records for themselves and others with the Pathway Prayer. Her revised book How to Read the Akashic Records is required reading.

courses.title: Akashic Records Level III: Advanced Manifesting Practitioner Certification
courses.description: The third recorded certification class, on recognising your soul's path and purposes and bringing them into the world. It follows Levels I and II.

courses.title: Akashic Records Teacher Training (Levels I, II and III)
courses.description: A training for graduates of all three certification classes that prepares them to teach her curriculum, with teaching protocols and outlines for each level.

courses.title: Personal Akashic Records Reading with Dr. Linda Howe
courses.description: A sixty-minute private reading, usually over Zoom, in which she opens the Records and explores the questions you bring. Appointments are limited around her teaching and writing.

free_resources.title: The Pathway Prayer Process
free_resources.description: The full text of her opening and closing prayer for the Akashic Records, free on her site with a printable copy. It is the starting point of all her classes.
